title: Mathematics Practice Test 1 - Mathematics - Exponential Functions
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Let $f(t) = 7e^{3t} + 1$. Which of the following numbers is closest to the value of $f(5)$?
questions.explain: Substitute $t = 5$: $f(5) = 7e^{15} + 1$. We know $e \approx 2.718$. $e^{15} \approx 3,269,017$ (or approx $3.27 \times 10^6$). Then $7 \times (3.27 \times 10^6) \approx 2.28 \times 10^7$. The closest value is $2 \times 10^7$.
